model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира сравнение между два различни подхода или метрики, означени като "Per-Output" и "Per-Layer", като стойностите им са показани като процент от обща скала, която варира от 100% до 800%. Хоризонталната ос показва процентните стъпки с етикети от 100% до 800% на равни интервали, докато вертикалната ос не е изрично етикетирана, но изглежда да представя величина или брой, съответстваща на всяка категория. Стойностите на "Per-Output" и "Per-Layer" са представени чрез различни цветове, съответно синьо и оранжево. При 100% и двете стойности са еднакви и много ниски, след което има постепенен ръст при увеличаване на процента. Най-значителен скок се наблюдава при достигане на 800%, където стойностите за двата подхода са най-високи, като "Per-Layer" показва малко по-висока стойност в сравнение с "Per-Output". Няма допълнително групиране или наслагване на стълбите, а всички те са подредени в последователни стъпки според процентните стойности на хоризонталната ос. Няма допълнителни бележки или визуални акценти върху определени стълби.
model_annotations.Chinese: This bar graph displays the comparison of two categories, labeled as "Per-Output" and "Per-Layer," across various percentage values. The horizontal axis represents the percentage range from 100% to 800%, marked in increments of 100%, with each tick labeled. The vertical axis, representing the values of the bars, does not have explicit labels but appears to increase linearly. The "Per-Output" category is represented by blue bars, while the "Per-Layer" category is represented by orange bars. The bars are grouped in pairs for each percentage value, with the "Per-Output" bar on the left and the "Per-Layer" bar on the right. The shortest bars for both categories are approximately at the 100% mark, with the "Per-Output" bar being slightly shorter than the "Per-Layer" bar. As the percentage increases, the height of both bars increases, with the "Per-Layer" bar generally being slightly taller than the "Per-Output" bar at each mark. Notably, at 800%, both bars reach their maximum height, with the "Per-Layer" bar appearing to be of equal or slightly greater height compared to the "Per-Output" bar. No specific numerical values are provided for the heights of the bars, but visually, there is a consistent increase in height for both categories as the percentage increases from 100% to 800%. The bars are not sorted in any specific order other than corresponding to their respective percentage values on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or annotations.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the per-output and per-layer values across different percentages, showcasing a comparison between two categories. The horizontal axis represents the percentage values, ranging from 100% to 800%, with evenly spaced tick labels marking each 100% increment on a linear scale. The vertical axis is unlabeled, with no visible units or scale type indicated. Two sets of bars, one in blue and the other in orange, represent the per-output and per-layer values, respectively. Each set consists of eight bars, with the blue bars having approximate values of 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 45%, 50%, and 85%, and the orange bars having approximate values of 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 55%, and 90%, with the bars increasing in height as the percentage values increase. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, but the per-output and per-layer values are visually grouped together for each percentage. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt einen Vergleich von zwei Metriken, „Per-Output“ und „Per-Layer“, über acht verschiedene Kategorien, die auf der horizontalen Achse angeordnet sind und prozentuale Werte von 100% bis 800% darstellen. Die horizontale Achse listet diese prozentualen Werte in Schritten von 100% auf und ist mit keinem spezifischen Titel versehen. Die vertikale Achse repräsentiert keine spezifisch benannte Größe, sondern scheint den relativen Wert oder Anteil darzustellen, mit einem Bereich, der sich aus den dargestellten Daten ergibt, aber keine spezifischen Einheiten oder Skalen zeigt. Das Diagramm enthält zwei Balkenreihen, eine für „Per-Output“ in blau und eine für „Per-Layer“ in orange. Die Balken für „Per-Output“ beginnen bei einem sehr niedrigen Wert bei 100% und steigen auf einen Höhepunkt bei etwa 800%, wo der höchste Balken ungefähr bei 90% der Höhe des Diagramms liegt. Die Balken für „Per-Layer“ zeigen einen ähnlichen Trend, beginnen bei einem etwas höheren Wert als „Per-Output“ bei 100% und erreichen ebenfalls ihren Höhepunkt bei 800%, wobei der Balken knapp unter der Höhe des „Per-Output“-Balkens bleibt. Beide Reihen zeigen eine allgemeine Steigerung der Werte, wobei die Balken länger werden, je weiter rechts sie sich auf der Achse befinden. Es gibt keine spezifische Sortierung oder Hervorhebung der Balken außer ihrer Farbcodierung gemäß der Legende.
